Title: Potential issues accessing Microsoft OneDrive content

User impact: Users may be unable to access OneDrive content and may notice delays or navigation errors.

Current Status: We're investigating a potential issue and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within one hour.

Title: Users may experience latency and get 503 service unavailable errors when accessing Microsoft OneDrive content

User impact: Users may experience latency and get 503 service unavailable errors when accessing OneDrive content.

Current status: We're using our service-side telemetry to help understand this issue and determine a remediation path.

Scope of impact: Your organization is impacted by this event, and users may experience latency and get 503 service unavailable errors when accessing OneDrive content.

Next update by: Thursday, October 1, 2026, at 7:00 PM UTC

Title: Users may experience latency and get 503 service unavailable errors when accessing Microsoft OneDrive content

User impact: Users may experience latency and get 503 service unavailable errors when accessing OneDrive content.
